description: Compare two DNS zone snapshots and report what the change does. Losing the last record of a type at a name stops something resolving once caches expire, and losing one value out of several does not, so the two are separated. A value change at one name is reported as a change rather than as an unrelated removal and addition. A TTL change is reported for its own reason: the old TTL governs how long the old answer survives, so a new one does not take effect until the old has expired. Pay 160000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

after.description: The later snapshot. Nothing resolves DNS: the records are supplied, which keeps the egress surface at zero and means an arbitrary domain can be audited without this service holding an allowlist for it.

name.description: The owner name. A trailing dot is ignored, so it does not create a second name.

ttl.description: Seconds. Omitting it means TTL rules are not applied to this record.

type.description: A record type such as A, MX, CNAME or TXT. A type this product does not model is reported as not checked.

value.description: The record data. For an MX, the preference and the host together.

before.description: The earlier snapshot. Nothing resolves DNS: the records are supplied, which keeps the egress surface at zero and means an arbitrary domain can be audited without this service holding an allowlist for it.

type.description: A record type such as A, MX, CNAME or TXT. A type this product does not model is reported as not checked.

name: dns_record_diff

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

removed_set_count.description: Names that lost every record of a type, which is the subset that stops something resolving.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

unchanged.description: True only when the two snapshots were identical.
